stories.title: U.S. and Iran miss peace talks deadline. And, Alaska, Florida and Wyoming primaries
stories.description: The U.S. and Iran missed a deadline to begin peace talks this week. The monthslong war has depleted U.S. resources. And, what to know about Alaska's U.S. Senate seat primary.

stories.title: War between U.S. and Iran shifts key resources away from Asia
stories.description: The U.S. focus on Iran has pivoted key resources away from another key geopolitical region -- Asia.

stories.title: Eleven killed in Israeli strikes on southern Lebanon, authorities say
stories.description: Israel's military said it had struck "Hezbollah terror infrastructure" in response to what it described as earlier action against its soldiers.

stories.title: Qatar denies capturing three Iranian pilots after downing fighter jets
stories.description: Iran claims they have been held since Qatar downed two fighter jets at the start of the US-Iran war.

stories.title: Lebanon parliament votes to abolish death penalty
stories.description: The new law - which next goes to the cabinet for approval - would make Lebanon the first country in the Middle East to end capital punishment.

stories.title: Houthis reportedly kill six in first deadly attack since start of Iran war
stories.description: Iran's proxy says it hit a ship with Saudi military equipment in the Red Sea, as tensions over the US-Iran war remain high.

stories.title: UAE imposes indefinite trade embargo on Iran over alleged missile attacks
stories.description: Iran denies launching missiles at the UAE, suggesting the incident was a 'false flag operation'.

stories.title: US sanctions International Criminal Court’s president and top lawyer
stories.description: The US has sanctioned International Criminal Court president Tomoko Akane and trial lawyer Abdoulaye Seye.

stories.title: Iran war live: Trump denies Iran talks, Tehran claims US ‘begging’
stories.description: Trump says no talks with Tehran scheduled; Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi claims US 'begging' for negotiations.

stories.title: Democrats call for USS Lincoln probe, question US Navy’s readiness
stories.description: Lawmakers question whether conditions on the aircraft carrier indicate a 'pattern' of poor planning amid the Iran war.

stories.title: Trump says no talks planned with Iran amid anger over Iran-Oman Hormuz deal
stories.description: US president hits out as states bordering the Strait of Hormuz continue talks on managing the strategic waterway.

stories.title: U.S. sanctions ICC chief Tomoko Akane of Japan
stories.description: These individuals have directly engaged in efforts by the ICC to investigate, arrest, detain, or prosecute officials whose government has not consented to ICC jurisdiction, U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio said in a statement

stories.title: West Asia war highlights: UAE accuses Iran of firing ballistic missiles at its territory
stories.description: Iran “categorically rejected the United Arab Emirates’ claim that Iran had launched a missile toward that country”, calling it harmful to regional trust and security efforts

stories.title: Houthis target refinery in southern Saudi Arabia: Media
stories.description: The Houthis "targeted the Aramco refinery in Jazan with several drones, in response to airspace violations over the governorates of Saada and Hajjah" in Yemen, Houthi news agency Saba said August 18, citing a military source

stories.title: Lebanon is handing over an Assad-era general after war crimes questioning
stories.description: Lebanon’s judicial authorities have decided to hand over a former Syrian military officer to Damascus

stories.title: How a dubious X post from India on Iran war went mainstream? | Explained
stories.description: A false quote supposedly first seen by an Indian handle was cited by the Israeli Prime Minister and the U.S. Ambassador to the United Nations

stories.title: US has changed tactics regarding Iran, halted negotiations — CNN
stories.description: According to sources cited by the TV channel, before resuming negotiations, Donald Trump wants to wait until the leaders of the Islamic Republic demonstrate their willingness to conclude the deal he is seeking

stories.title: US claim for Strait of Hormuz far from its real capabilities — Iranian official
stories.description: Secretary of Iran’s Supreme National Security Council Mohsen Rezaei invited all interested parties to create a new cooperation framework in the region "that will succeed the US hegemony in the Persian Gulf zone"

stories.title: UAE halts trade, financial transactions with Iran — Foreign Ministry
stories.description: The decision was made after the country’s air defense systems identified the launch of two ballistic missiles from Iran

stories.title: More pressure on Iran unlikely to produce concessions outside deal with US — speaker
stories.description: Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf added that US Secretary of the Treasury Scott Bessent and Secretary of War Pete Hegseth are "way out of their league"
